newsitem.title: USA: Butler National Q2 off on food unit woes.
newsitem.headline: Butler National Q2 off on food unit woes.

text.p: Butler National Corp Tuesday blamed operational problems at its Food Distribution segment for a 90-percent drop in net income in its fiscal second quarter to $6,000 from $64,000.

The company said the problems caused a delay in the opening of a second Valu Foods test store and hurt services to the first test store. Butler National said it is working to correct the problems and expand the Valu Foods concept.
Butler National reported second-quarter sales of $6.1 million, up 45 percent from $4.2 million one year ago.
Butler National manages aerospace and services operations.
Its stock was down 1/16 Tuesday afternoon to 2-1/4.
